scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
Welcome
to ^8B4513Einbroch^000000,
the City of Steel.
Please ask me if you
have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
欢迎来到钢铁之城^8B4513艾音布罗克^000000。
如果有任何问题，请随时问我。

scripts.text:
[Einbroch Guide]
The <NAVI>[Airport]<INFO>einbroch,64,204,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI> is located
in the northwestern part
of the city. There you can
see our city's pride and joy, the Airship. Remember that you must pay admission to board the Airship.
scripts.translation:
[艾音布罗克向导]
<NAVI>[机场]<INFO>einbroch,64,204,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>位于城市的西北部。
在那里您可以看到我们城市的骄傲——飞空艇。
请记住，搭乘飞空艇需要付费。

and Einbech run all day

Einbech. It's a nice place
to relax after a long day.

scripts.text:
[Einbech Guide]
The <NAVI>[Mine]<INFO>einbech,137,248,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>, which is
Einbech's major industry,
is located in the northern
part of this town. It's where
we get all our ores, although monsters get in the miners' way.
scripts.translation:
[艾音贝赫向导]
<NAVI>[矿场]<INFO>einbech,137,248,0,000,0</INFO></NAVI>是艾音贝赫的产业支柱，位于城镇北部。
我们的矿石都来自那里，不过魔物总是妨碍矿工工作。
